name: GROWING PROBLEMS
source:
You are part of a typical family.
This means you argue, fight, and get mad at each other.
But you also work together to get what you need... most of the time.
Having many people living in one house can be challenging, then add raging hormones, and every day can feel like a ticking time bomb or be the best day of their life.

[From F95 ZONE]
